
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Excel 中设置下拉列表是规范数据录入的常用手段。手动操作虽然简单，但当需要为多个文件或大量单元格批量添加时，用 Python 自动化会更高效。Free Spire.XLS for Python 提供了两种直接的方式：一是通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Values</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性直接指定选项列表，二是通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DataRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性引用工作表中的单元格区域。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装免费库：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install spire.xls.free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">代码中需要导入 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">spire.xls</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">spire.xls.common</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心对象：DataValidation</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Free Spire.XLS 中，下拉列表本质上是一种“列表类型”的数据验证。每个单元格区域（CellRange）都有一个 DataValidation 属性，通过配置这个对象即可实现下拉列表。最常用的两个设置项是：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DataValidation.DataRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：将某个单元格区域作为选项来源。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DataValidation.Values</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：直接用一个字符串列表作为选项。</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">设置完成后，目标区域中的每个单元格都会出现下拉箭头，用户只能从预设选项中选择（或根据错误提示设置决定是否允许手动输入）。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">下面分别介绍这两种方式。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方法一：直接设置选项值</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果选项固定且数量不多，可以直接在代码中列出，无需在工作表中占用额外区域。这种方式生成的文件更简洁，选项配置完全由代码控制。</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>workbook = Workbook()<br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]<br>
sheet.Name = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"员工信息"</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 写入表头</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"A1"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"姓名"</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"C1"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"职位"</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 目标单元格区域：C2 到 C10</span><br>
cellRange = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"C2:C10"</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 直接设置下拉列表的选项值（中文）</span><br>
cellRange.DataValidation.Values = [<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"实习生"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"技术员"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"主管"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"总监"</span>]</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"职位下拉列表.xlsx"</span>, FileFormat.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Values</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 接受一个 Python 字符串列表，库会自动将其转换为 Excel 的列表验证。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方法二：引用单元格区域</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这种方式适合选项较多、需要动态维护的场景。选项数据存放在工作表的某个区域，目标单元格引用该区域。修改选项时只需编辑数据区域，无需改动代码。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">我们创建一个新的工作簿，在 F 列写入部门选项，然后在 B2:B10 区域创建下拉列表引用这些选项。</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建工作簿并加载文件</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Sample.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 获取第一个工作表</span><br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets.get_Item(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 选定需要设置下拉列表的单元格范围</span><br>
cellRange = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"C3:C7"</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 将数据验证的数据范围设置为 F4:H4</span><br>
cellRange.DataValidation.DataRange = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"F4:H4"</span>]</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 保存文件</span><br>
workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"output/DropDownListExcel.xlsx"</span>, FileFormat.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DataRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 接受一个 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">CellRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象，指向包含选项的单元格区域。被引用的区域可以是同一工作表，也可以是同一工作簿中的其他工作表（例如将选项集中放在一个“数据源”表中）。需要注意的是，引用的区域最好是一行或一列，避免多行多列造成选项读取顺序不符合预期。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">跨工作表引用：</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果选项数据在另一个工作表中，只需把 sheet.Range["F1:H4"] 换成对应工作表的范围。例如：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">data_sheet = workbook.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 第二个工作表</span>
data_sheet.Name = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数据源"</span>
data_sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"A1"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"人事部"</span>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># ... 其他选项</span>
cellRange.DataValidation.DataRange = data_sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"A1:A10"</span>]
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">两种方法的对比与选择</span></h2>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; display: table; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.95em; text-align: left; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对比项</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">引用单元格区域</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">直接指定选项值</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">选项维护</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Excel 中编辑，非技术人员也能修改</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">修改代码，重新生成</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">工作表整洁度</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">需要额外的数据区域</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">不占用单元格</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">选项数量限制</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">基本无限制（受 Excel 行数限制）</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">总字符数不超过 255</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">适用场景</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">选项经常变动、数量较多</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">选项固定、数量较少</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实际使用时可以根据需求灵活选择。如果是一次性生成或选项极少，方式一更直接；如果模板需要交给业务人员长期维护，推荐方式二。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">进阶：错误提示与输入提示</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">数据验证不仅能限制输入，还能在用户操作时给出中文引导。设置完 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DataRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 或 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Values</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 后，可以继续配置以下属性：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 错误提示：用户输入了不在列表中的内容时触发</span>
cellRange.DataValidation.ShowError = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span>
cellRange.DataValidation.ErrorTitle = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"输入无效"</span>
cellRange.DataValidation.ErrorMessage = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"请从下拉列表中选择，不要手动输入。"</span>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 输入提示：单元格被选中时显示</span><br>
cellRange.DataValidation.ShowInput = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
cellRange.DataValidation.InputTitle = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"请选择"</span><br>
cellRange.DataValidation.InputMessage = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"从下拉列表中选择一个选项。"</span><br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ShowError</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">True</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 时，无效输入会弹出错误对话框。</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AlertStyle</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可以设置为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Stop</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（阻止输入）、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Warning</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 或 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Information</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（仅提示但允许继续）。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ShowInput</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">True</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 时，用户点击单元格会看到输入提示，可以在输入前就给出指导。</span></li>
</ul></section>
